Eagle Wireless

Embedded Software Engineer

Embedded Software Engineer

About Eagle Wireless

Eagle Wireless is building the connective tissue of the physical world.

Every connected car, every industrial sensor, every IoT device that needs to talk to the cloud reliably and securely — that’s where we come in. We design and deliver cellular modules and connectivity solutions that automotive, and IoT companies trust to work for years, in the field, without compromise.

Our teams span North America, Europe, and APAC, giving you the chance to collaborate with world-class engineers and go-to-market experts solving hard problems at global scale — from cybersecurity and supply chain resilience to regulatory compliance across dozens of markets.

If you want your work to matter in a world that’s rapidly connecting everything, and you want to do it alongside people obsessed with getting the hard stuff right, Eagle Wireless is where that happens. 

Job Summary:

Join our team to design, develop, and integrate firmware for next-generation cellular modules. You'll be part of a cross-functional team building embedded applications and low-level software that interact directly with wireless hardware, including LTE, 5G, and IoT technologies, and will help drive technical decisions around architecture, performance, and reliability in production environments.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and debug embedded software for wireless modules and microcontroller-based systems
Work closely with hardware and RF engineering teams on platform bring-up and hardware/software integration
Implement and test device drivers, communication protocols (e.g., UART, SPI, I2C), and middleware
Support cellular module integration, certification testing (PTCRB, FCC, carrier-specific), and connectivity troubleshooting
Contribute to and help define software development workflows, including version control, continuous integration, and code reviews
Guide board bring-up and protocol stack development, and mentor other engineers on best practices, tooling, and documentation

Qualifications/Skills/Knowledge:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
Experience in embedded systems development, including bare-metal and/or RTOS environments
Proficiency in C and/or C++ for embedded systems, with experience in low-level hardware bring-up and debugging
Solid understanding of embedded systems architecture, memory management, and peripheral interfaces
Familiarity with debugging tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD
Ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary team environment
Experience with cellular modules (e.g., Quectel, Telit Cinterion, Semtech), including AT command sets and network troubleshooting
Knowledge of 4G/5G connectivity, eSIM/eUICC integration, SIM interfaces, or GNSS functionality
Familiarity with Yocto, Linux kernel/device tree customization, secure boot, or FOTA practices
Understanding of wireless protocols such as TCP/IP, MQTT, or CoAP in constrained devices
Experience building test harnesses, automated validation frameworks, or manufacturing test development
Strong communication skills and ability to work independently or lead others

Our work environment is collaborative, and we offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, which includes medical/dental/vision, generous PTO and paid parental leave programs.

Eagle Wireless recognizes the importance of forming inclusive teams to foster an environment where creative solutions are made for our clients, and all have the opportunity to thrive and succeed. We encourage candidates from a variety of backgrounds to apply to be a part of our team.
